pr.title: Harden the server binaries: /sdl, Control Flow Guard, Spectre mitigations, CET
pr.body:
## Summary

Phase 0b2 of the modernization roadmap: security hardening for the server binaries `hMailServer.exe` and `hMailServer.Minidump.exe`, in Debug and Release.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/sdl` | Extra security checks: stricter `/GS`, pointer sanitization, member initialization, and more warnings treated as errors |
| `/guard:cf` (compiler and linker) | **Control Flow Guard**: hijacked indirect calls are blocked |
| `/Qspectre` | Spectre variant 1 mitigations. Links the Spectre-mitigated CRT and ATL libraries, which the CI image has. |
| `/CETCOMPAT` | Compatible with **CET hardware shadow stacks** (return-address protection) |

ASLR (including high-entropy ASLR) and DEP were already the x64 defaults. They're now covered by tests too.

## Bug found by `/sdl`

`/sdl` flagged `ADOConnection::Execute` with C4703 (potentially uninitialized pointer). The `@@IDENTITY` query string was allocated in one `if` block and freed in a second one. Behind the warning was a real **leak**: the string was never freed when `Recordset::Open` threw. `SQLCEConnection` had the same leak. Both now use a `_bstr_t` inside a single block.

## Tests

New `Infrastructure\BinaryHardening` regression tests read the installed executables' PE headers and check:
- `DYNAMIC_BASE`, `HIGH_ENTROPY_VA` and `NX_COMPAT` (ASLR, high-entropy ASLR, DEP)
- `GUARD_CF` (Control Flow Guard)
- the `CET_COMPAT` extended DLL characteristic

A dropped flag would otherwise build and run without anyone noticing.

✅ CI [Build run](https://github.com/jassifx/arzoiemail/actions/runs/40067733202): **1,174 passed, 0 failed.** That's the baseline of 1,168 plus the 6 new hardening tests, which all pass for both executables. Inconclusive (34) and skipped (75) are unchanged.

## Not in this PR

`/W4` waits for Phase 5 (code quality). With warnings-as-errors on, it would produce thousands of errors in the old code.

commit.message:
Harden the server binaries: /sdl, Control Flow Guard, Spectre mitigations, CET

For hMailServer.exe and hMailServer.Minidump.exe, in both configurations:
- /sdl (SDLCheck): additional security checks at compile time and run time.
- /guard:cf (ControlFlowGuard, compiler and linker): Control Flow Guard.
- /Qspectre (SpectreMitigation), linked against the Spectre-mitigated CRT and ATL
  libraries that the windows-2025-vs2026 image carries.
- /CETCOMPAT (CETCompat): compatible with CET hardware shadow stacks.

ASLR, high-entropy ASLR and DEP were already the x64 defaults. The new
Infrastructure\BinaryHardening regression tests read the installed executables' PE
headers and fail if any of these markings is missing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Free the @@IDENTITY query string when the identity lookup throws

/sdl reports C4703 for ADOConnection::Execute: bsIdentity was allocated in one if
block and freed in a second one with the same condition. Besides the warning, it
leaked whenever Recordset::Open threw, and so did the same code in SQLCEConnection.
Use a _bstr_t in both, inside a single block.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

BinaryHardening tests: import RegressionTests.Shared for TestFixtureBase

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
